⚫⚪ Checkers

Tap one of your pieces, then tap a glowing square to move.

How captures & kings work

Jump diagonally over an opponent's piece into the empty square just beyond it to capture it — like hopping over a friend's counter. If the same piece can jump again straight away, keep going!

Reach the far row and your piece becomes a King 👑 — kings can move backwards too.

🎴 Uno

You drew a card — play it or keep it?

Choose a colour:

Your hand — tap a card to play it

How Wild & action cards work

Match the colour or the number of the top card — or play a Wild any time. Skip 🚫 jumps over the next player's go. Reverse 🔄 flips who goes next. +2 and Wild +4 make the next player pick up cards and miss their go. A Wild +4 can only be played when you have no card left in the colour that's currently in play.

🌈 Rainbow Words

Guess the mystery word before the clouds cover the sun — get it, and a rainbow bursts out!

Relaxed mode — the clouds drift by, but never cover the sun

Type a word for the group to guess. It stays hidden as dots, so the shared screen doesn't give it away.

Word detective tips

Start with the vowels — A, E, I, O, U. Nearly every word has at least one.

Then try the busy consonants — S, T, R, N, L and D turn up all the time.

Use the clue — the picture or the theme narrows it right down, and the blanks tell you how many letters to find.

Know it? Type the whole word in the box. A wrong-length guess is just a nudge — it never costs a cloud.
